div.div:
1 October
User E1: “My name is Maya. I live in Chennai. I work as a software engineer at NovaTech, and I work remotely.”
Assistant E2: “Hi Maya! What would you like help with today?”
10 October
User E3: “I moved from Chennai to Bengaluru today. Bengaluru is now my home city. I still work remotely as a software engineer at NovaTech.”
Assistant E4: “Understood, Maya. Your home city has changed to Bengaluru, while your job and remote working arrangement remain the same.”
